It is the only non-test INSERT producer of wamn_run.runs and run_queue found in services, components, execution and runtime source.

Current management-admitter grants include only wirings and component_library among catalog tables. PostgreSQL requires privilege on referenced tables even for empty requirement sets.
blocking_contract_input.governing_change: 46514ab9421223434418812f615cab892d60bded / wamn-10yt.10.14 intentionally removes the six orphaned management catalog reads. Do not restore them to arm a proof.
blocking_contract_input.management_gate: services/scenario-worker/src/store/admission.rs:901 says Gate judges a document, writes nothing, and executes no cases. Accepted reports summarize case count, not execution verdicts (873 onward). Publish materializes wiring; neither queues execution.
blocking_contract_input.design_gap: docs/exe-model.md:102 describes automation admission, but this source has no surviving production caller of the run/queue insert recipe. Charter docs/wamn_wasmcloud_2_9_cutover.md:125 still requires queued delivery.
blocking_contract_input.owner_question: Which current production command owns automation admission with the narrowed management grant set? If none exists, this needs a separately owned producer implementation/contract decision before an end-to-end queue proof can be armed.
blocking_contract_input.scope_boundary: Direct superuser INSERTs or copied admission SQL would be test seeding, not evidence of an existing production admission path. Re-expanding authority, restoring removed draft execution, or adding a new queue API is outside this bounded cutover proof.

already_available_evidence.scope: Real process binary, scoped guest/executor/http-admitter credentials, exact OCI release, native readiness/liveness, idle SIGTERM and SIGINT exits inside 15-second deployment grace. It intentionally admits no runs.
Generic serve_queue turn held by Notify; proves stop finishes one injected turn and starts no next turn. No PostgreSQL, RouterDriver or real guest execution.
Stopped queue does not start a turn or liveness. Not active-work evidence.

conditional_smallest_proof_after_produce.integration_point: Extend the existing idle executor block at tools/receiving-cluster-journey-run:1118 before materializer traffic, reusing the exact released closure, scoped credentials, owned child, probe port and cleanup. Do not create another cluster or executor harness.

existing_operation.name: purchase_order.get
existing_operation.input_shape: Use the released route/operation input envelope already used by the journey, with a unique request_id and id equal to the known row. Do not assume the route wiring takes a bare operation envelope; resolve its actual released graph.

conditional_smallest_proof_after_produce.bounded_hold: An owned fixture-controller transaction may hold ACCESS EXCLUSIVE on receiving.purchase_order while the real guest SELECT waits. This changes no schema or grants. The serving executor keeps its existing least-authority guest and executor-platform credentials; only the fresh fixture controller owns the temporary test lock.
measurement_sequence: Admit exactly two uniquely identified standard runs through the current production producer (presently missing); both target the same immutable released operation.

Start the existing real executor and observe the first queue run leased to its unique owner/generation plus an actual guest SELECT waiting on the owned purchase_order lock. Readiness alone or a leased row alone is insufficient active-guest evidence.
Send SIGTERM (then repeat independently for SIGINT), observe native readiness report draining/503, and confirm the process stays alive while the owned guest SELECT is still blocked.

Release the lock promptly within the 5-second native command drain budget. Require the first run result to contain the exact purchase-order success and its queue row to be deleted; require the second run to remain unclaimed.

Require zero process exit within the 15-second deployment grace, exact owned-child cleanup, and no admission of a subsequent queue turn. Preserve times, owner/generation, run identities, result and queue observations with private credentials excluded.
conditional_smallest_proof_after_produce.active_timeout_variant: A hold beyond the 5-second drain could measure bounded refusal with its durable lease left fenced, but that is a different acceptance claim from successful active drain and must not replace it.

exact_existing_commands.scope: Existing deterministic lifecycle unit only; not queued-delivery proof. Already covered by normal validation; no rerun requested here.
Existing stale admission owner can diagnose its own permissions on a fresh fixture; not an authorized shortcut for cutover proof. Do not run inside Receiving database.
exact_existing_commands.required_private_environment: WAMN_RUN_STORE_PG_URL to a fresh owned PG18 fixture; existing test internally uses psql URL arguments.

execution: No Cargo, build, Docker, live database, network, source edit, or Beads mutation performed. No implementation patch prepared because admission is a contract/input gap.
